title: 第八章 被造黄谣，钻被窝
slug: 抢恶姐婚约随军被禁欲大佬亲哭
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

这个坏女人突然跑来找沈时觐干嘛？

这里面一定有问题。

林栀抱着胳膊，盯着木门思考。

以她对绿茶婊的了解，她很快就得出结论。

林柔不是来道歉就是来说她坏话的。

总之，她这个时间过来不可能是来钻他被窝的。

门外的声音还在继续。

“时觐哥，我可以进来吗？”

林栀没再多想，踮起脚尖转身，轻手轻脚的进了里屋。

她想了想，无比认真的看向沈时觐，轻声道：“我知道你对我有意见，可不管一会儿林柔跟你说了什么，我都希望你能好好判断一下她话的真假。”

说完她就放下了屋里的门帘，一屁股坐在了炕沿上。

沈时觐瞥了她一眼，沉默几秒，转身去了门口。

开门后。

林柔看到沈时觐，脸上立刻露出甜甜笑容：“时觐哥，刚才我实在是太伤心了才会对你态度不好的，你别生我气了，好不好？”

她的声音里透着亲昵。

林栀隔着门帘，听着林柔夹到不能再夹的声音，感慨道，她要是生在现代社会就好了，完全可以做一个不露脸的声优主播，估计会有不少榜一大哥。

“我没放在心上。”沈时觐站得笔直，神色淡淡：“你找我还有别的事吗？”

虽然他不信林栀刚才说的话，可那也不代表他对林柔没看法。

林柔滞了几秒，攥紧衣角，欲言又止道：“时觐哥，其实……我找你还有别的事要说，可这事不好让外人听见，要不我们俩还是进屋说吧？”

说着，她的一只脚就要迈进门槛。

“不方便，你就在这说吧。”

男女有别，就算林栀不在里面，沈时觐也不会让她进屋的。

林柔尴尬的收回那只脚，眼睛红红的。

“时觐哥，你一定要对我这么冷淡吗？是不是我做错什么了？还是栀栀跟你说了些什么？你对我有误会？”

她在屋里想了许久，除了林栀跟他说了自己的坏话，她实在是想不到他不选自己的理由。

她凑他近了些：“时觐哥，你要不要再好好考虑一下，我比栀栀……”

沈时觐眉头皱了下，后退一步跟她拉开了些距离：“我就要结婚了，男女有别，你别凑我这么近。”

林栀嘴角翘了翘，沈时觐也跟她说过类似的话。

她不还是把他拿下了。

她倒不是得意。

她清楚沈时觐只是迫于责任才答应的，如果昨晚换作是林柔钻了他被窝，他也一定会跟她结婚的。

想想……沈时觐也挺倒霉的。

他明明有那么好的出身，自身条件也优越，却因为幼时两家老人订下的娃娃亲，被迫娶一个陌生女人进门。

这就是这个时代的局限性。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Why did this bad woman suddenly come to see Shen Shijin?

There must be something wrong here.

Lin Zhi crossed her arms and stared at the wooden door, thinking.

With her knowledge of green tea bitches, she quickly came to a conclusion.

Lin Rou was either here to apologize or to say bad things about her.

In short, she couldn't have come here at this time just to get into his bed.

The sound outside the door continued.

"Brother Shi Jin, can I come in?"

Lin Zhi didn't think any more, turned around on tiptoes, and quietly entered the back room.

She thought for a while, looked at Shen Shijin very seriously, and said softly: "I know you have opinions about me, but no matter what Lin Rou says to you later, I hope you can judge the truth of her words."

After saying that, she put down the door curtain in the room and sat down on the edge of the Kang.

Shen Shijin glanced at her, was silent for a few seconds, then turned and went to the door.

After opening the door.

When Lin Rou saw Shen Shijin, a sweet smile immediately appeared on her face: "Brother Shijin, I was so sad that I treated you badly just now. Please stop being angry with me, okay?"

There was endearment in her voice.

Through the curtain, Lin Zhi listened to the sound of Lin Rou pinching her until she could no longer pinch her, and said with emotion that it would be great if she was born in modern society. She could be a faceless seiyuu anchor, and she would probably have many big names on the list.

"I don't take it to heart." Shen Shijin stood upright with a calm expression: "Do you have anything else to do with me?"

Although he didn't believe what Lin Zhi said just now, it didn't mean that he had no opinions on Lin Rou.

Lin Rou hesitated for a few seconds, clenched the corners of her clothes tightly, and hesitated to speak: "Brother Shi Jin, actually... I have something else to say to you, but it's not something outsiders can hear. How about we go into the room and talk?"

As she spoke, one of her feet was about to step over the threshold.

"It's inconvenient, just say it here."

There are differences between men and women. Even if Lin Zhi is not inside, Shen Shijin will not let her enter the house.

Lin Rou retracted her foot in embarrassment, her eyes red.

"Brother Shi Jin, do you have to be so cold to me? Did I do something wrong? Or did Zhi Zhi say something to you? Do you misunderstand me?"

She thought about it for a long time in the room. Apart from Lin Zhi telling him bad things about herself, she really couldn't think of a reason why he didn't choose her.

She moved closer to him: "Brother Shi Jin, do you want to think about it again? I'm better than Zhi Zhi..."

Shen Shijin frowned, took a step back and distanced himself from her: "I'm about to get married. There are differences between men and women, so don't get so close to me."

The corners of Lin Zhi's lips curled up. Shen Shijin also said similar words to her.

Didn't she take him down anyway.

She was not proud.

She knew that Shen Shijin only agreed because of responsibility. If Lin Rou had gotten into his bed last night, he would have married her.

Think about it... Shen Shijin is also quite unlucky.

He obviously has such a good background and his own conditions are superior, but because of a child marriage arranged by the two elders when he was young, he was forced to marry a strange woman.

This is the limitation of this era.
